players.name: Haaland
players.notes: 4/4 starts, four 90s; MCI's only senior FWD; pens #1. C18 streak tier — the one FWD earning 0.93.

players.name: Isak

players.name: Thiago
players.notes: 4/4 starts; pens #1; Wilson 13' all season. 5 pts belies xG 2.41 — finishing, not role, is the problem.

players.name: João Pedro

players.name: Havertz
players.notes: 4/4 starts; Gyokeres has 12' all season and is -0.3. MED not LOW: a 7.2m striker reclaiming the shirt inside the window is a live, if quiet, risk.

players.name: Wissa
players.notes: 4/4 starts; Woltemade loaned to Juventus, Osula injured — the only fit senior NEW striker. pens #2.

players.name: Gonzalo
players.notes: 4/4 starts, pens #1; Muniz 28' all season. 76' GW4 the only hook.

players.name: Barry
players.notes: 4/4 starts, pens #1; Beto sold to Fiorentina leaves no competition. xG 2.98 is third in the position.

players.name: McBurnie
players.notes: 4/4 starts, pens #1, Ansah injured and Vaz 8' — nailed. HIGH is the promoted-club band (HUL att 0.68, worst in the league), not a minutes doubt.

players.name: Calvert-Lewin
players.notes: 4/4 starts, pens #1; hooked at 72' and 77' in the last two, and Nmecha has 50' — enough to keep him off the 0.93 tier.

players.name: Evanilson
players.notes: 4/4 starts, two full 90s most recently after 74'/80' openers; Rodriguez and Jebbison offer nothing.

players.name: Brobbey
players.notes: 4/4 starts, two 90s. Isidor has 14 pts from 95 sub minutes — the most credible bench claim on any starter's shirt in the position.

players.name: Emersonn
players.reason: Hooked every start (65/45/65/62, mean 59.3) so the 90' default overstates him; but three of four cleared the 60' appearance threshold, so a sub-60 mean would wrongly zero his 2-pt appearances — 62 is the least-wrong single value. attack_mult 0.85: promoted club, no PL history before this season, so the league-mean prior flatters him.
players.notes: 24 pts in 237' is the best minutes-adjusted return outside the elite. Raised from 0.70 — he has started all four; the ceiling is the hook, and that belongs in minutes_per_start, not p_start.

players.name: Kostoulas
players.notes: Started GW2-4 after a GW1 cameo. Ferguson due back 10 Oct (~GW8), hence the taper; David and Georginio are not competition.

players.name: Marmoush
players.notes: Started GW2-4 but minutes decaying 90/83/76 while Solanke went 62' in GW4. pens #2 behind Solanke's #1. TOT att 0.74 caps the ceiling regardless.

players.name: N.Jackson
players.notes: Started GW2-4 but 45' in GW4 with Abraham taking the other 45 — a share forming, not a nailed lead. Watkins gone to Al Hilal; pens #2.

players.name: Delap
players.notes: Clean ramp 0/24/73/90 — has taken the NFO shirt off Igor Jesus. pens #3. Biggest riser in the position; 0.80 not higher because the streak is two rounds old.

players.name: Strand Larsen
players.notes: 83' in GW4 and CRY's lead while Mateta is out (hamstring, due 11 Oct ~GW8) and Nketiah was benched. Taper prices Mateta's return.

players.name: Thomas-Asante
players.reason: Promoted club with no meaningful PL scoring history; the league-mean default for a regular starter overstates his rate.
players.notes: Awoniyi suspended to 19 Oct (~GW9) opens the COV lead; he has the most minutes of the three claimants. COV att 0.74 keeps the ceiling low.

players.name: Solanke
players.notes: Fitness ramp 22/15/6/62 — the GW4 hour is the signal. pens #1 ahead of Marmoush, so a start carries outsized upside; Richarlison out of the squad.

players.name: Abraham
players.notes: Ramping 0/19/5/45; split GW4 with Jackson 45-45. Watkins sold and Madjo injured make him the clear AVL #2.

players.name: Isidor
players.notes: 0 starts but 14 pts from 95 sub minutes. Pushing Brobbey; a start is a matter of when, not if, though the sample is tiny.

players.name: Nketiah
players.notes: Cut from 0.70: fit since 12 Sep yet played 0' in GW4 having started GW1-3. Lost the shirt to Strand Larsen; Mateta's return pushes him down again.

players.name: Igor Jesus
players.notes: Cut from 0.50: 90/90/31/15 is a clean displacement by Delap. pens #4 is no consolation.

players.name: Fernandez-Pardo
players.reason: No PL history — the position league-mean default for a regular starter badly flatters a squad option at a weak-attack club (NEW att 0.87).
players.notes: Two appearances (27', 57'), trending up, but Wissa is the only fit senior striker and is nailed. New-signing cap applies.

players.name: Simms
players.notes: Second claimant on the COV lead while Awoniyi is suspended; 69' in GW1 is his high-water mark.

players.name: Šeško
players.notes: 0 starts; four near-identical cameos (23/10/20/23). MUN are starting no nominal FWD — a structural, not a form, problem.

players.name: Gyökeres
players.notes: 0 starts, 12' all season, -0.3 price. Havertz owns the ARS shirt. Retained above Seskо only because the price fall implies a cheap re-entry if he starts.

players.name: David
players.notes: 0 starts, 23' all season; Kostoulas ahead and Ferguson due back. pens #2 is the only hook.

players.name: Welbeck
players.notes: GW5 bump is the Joao Pedro flag; Emegha due back 18 Sep restores the queue behind him from GW6.

players.name: Cherif
players.reason: Promoted club, no PL history; league-mean default for a regular starter is the wrong prior for a 30-minute debutant.
players.notes: First minutes in GW4 (30') as Awoniyi's suspension bit. Third in the COV queue.

players.name: Wood
players.notes: 28/0/16/1 and -0.2; marginalised behind Delap and Igor Jesus despite pens #2.

players.name: Flemming
players.notes: 6 pts in 51' across two cameos; Emersonn's hook at ~60' is his route in. No attack discount: he carries a real PL prior (history_past), unlike the other promoted-club fringe rows.

players.name: Nmecha
players.notes: 50' all season behind a nailed Calvert-Lewin; pens #2 only matters if CBL is out.

players.name: Georginio
players.notes: Cut from 0.35: started GW1 then 0' in three straight. Kostoulas has the shirt.

players.name: Akpom
players.reason: Promoted club; prior is Championship-weighted and the league-mean fallback overstates PL finishing.
players.notes: Cut from 0.25: 24/45/0/0 is a fade, not a rotation.

players.notes: 10' all season behind a nailed Evanilson.
